description: This file contains the implementation of an AI move calculation for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, including the getBestMove function that uses a minimax algorithm, along with helper functions for evaluating the game state.

methods.name: getBestMove
methods.description: Returns the best move index for the AI player using a minimax algorithm with depth scoring.

methods.name: minimax
methods.description: Recursively evaluates game states to determine the optimal move score for the AI or human player.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner in the current board state.
